headline: Apple beats quarterly estimates as iPhone demand stays strong
body: Apple reported revenue of $94.9 billion, up 6% year over year, beating analyst expectations. Services hit a record high and the company raised its dividend.

headline: Fed signals rates will stay higher for longer
body: Federal Reserve officials said inflation remains sticky and signalled no rate cuts this year. Treasury yields jumped and markets priced in a possible further hike.

headline: Boeing halts 737 MAX deliveries after new quality defect
body: Boeing said it would halt deliveries of the 737 MAX after inspectors found a manufacturing defect. The regulator opened an investigation, and the company warned of a delay to its production targets.

headline: Tensions escalate in the Strait as naval exercises expand
body: Military drills near a key shipping lane escalated overnight. Analysts warned that sanctions and supply chain disruption could follow if the conflict widens, hitting chipmakers including Nvidia and Apple.

headline: Microsoft agrees to acquire cybersecurity firm in $16 billion deal
body: Microsoft announced a definitive agreement to acquire a cybersecurity company for $16 billion in cash. The acquisition is expected to close next year, subject to regulatory approval.

headline: Nvidia unveils next-generation AI chip with record performance
body: Nvidia launched its new data-center GPU, claiming twice the performance of the previous generation. Major cloud providers including Microsoft and Amazon said they would adopt the chip.

headline: Rating agency downgrades regional lender to junk on deposit outflows
body: A major rating agency downgraded a mid-sized regional bank to junk status, citing deposit outflows and rising loan losses in commercial real estate. Peers including Bank of America fell in sympathy.

headline: Oil surges after OPEC+ announces surprise output cut
body: Crude prices jumped 7% after OPEC+ announced an unexpected production cut. Energy stocks such as Exxon and Chevron rallied, while airlines slumped on higher fuel costs.

headline: Pfizer drug fails late-stage trial
body: Pfizer said its experimental treatment failed to meet its primary endpoint in a phase 3 trial. The company will take an impairment charge and shares fell sharply in early trading.

headline: JPMorgan reports record trading revenue
body: JPMorgan posted record markets revenue and raised full-year guidance on net interest income. Jamie Dimon said the consumer remains resilient but warned about geopolitical risk.

headline: US CPI comes in hotter than expected
body: Consumer prices rose 0.6% in August, above the 0.3% forecast. Core inflation accelerated, raising the odds of another rate hike and pushing bond yields to a 16-year high.

headline: Tesla recalls 2 million vehicles over autopilot safety concerns
body: Tesla is recalling more than two million vehicles after a safety regulator probe into its driver-assistance system. Elon Musk said the fix would be delivered by software update.

headline: New export controls target advanced semiconductors
body: The government announced sweeping export controls and sanctions on advanced semiconductors and chipmaking tools. Nvidia and Intel warned the restrictions could cut revenue in the region.

headline: Amazon launches new AI shopping assistant
body: Amazon rolled out a generative AI shopping assistant to all US customers. Analysts said the launch strengthens AWS and could lift advertising revenue.

headline: Property developer misses bond coupon payment
body: A large property developer failed to make a coupon payment on its offshore dollar bonds, entering a grace period. Creditors are preparing for a possible restructuring and contagion fears hit bank stocks.

headline: Chevron completes merger with independent producer
body: Chevron completed its all-stock merger after receiving final regulatory approval. Management expects $1 billion in annual cost synergies.

headline: Unemployment rises to 4.6% as hiring slows sharply
body: Nonfarm payrolls grew by just 40,000 last month and the unemployment rate rose to 4.6%. Economists say recession risk is rising.

headline: Meta fined record sum by EU regulators over data transfers
body: European regulators fined Meta a record amount for violating data privacy rules and ordered it to suspend transfers. Meta said it would appeal the decision.

headline: Walmart raises outlook as shoppers trade down
body: Walmart raised its full-year outlook after strong same-store sales growth. Grocery market share gains and e-commerce growth beat expectations.

headline: Ceasefire talks collapse and conflict escalates
body: Diplomatic talks collapsed overnight and missile strikes were reported near energy infrastructure. Oil jumped, gold hit a record and global stocks sold off on the escalation of war risk.

headline: Mid-cap manufacturer files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
body: An industrial manufacturer filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after defaulting on its term loan. Lenders face significant losses on the leveraged loan.

headline: Alphabet wins dismissal of antitrust claim
body: A federal judge dismissed a key antitrust claim against Google, a significant legal win for Alphabet. Shares rose in afternoon trading.

headline: Goldman Sachs to sell consumer unit at a loss
body: Goldman Sachs agreed to sell its consumer lending unit, booking a loss on the divestiture. The bank said the deal frees capital for its core businesses.

headline: Johnson & Johnson settles talc litigation
body: Johnson & Johnson reached a settlement to resolve most talc lawsuits, removing a long-running legal overhang. Analysts called the resolution a positive outcome.

headline: ECB unexpectedly cuts rates as euro-area growth stalls
body: The European Central Bank cut its deposit rate by 25 basis points, surprising markets. Policymakers cited weak growth and easing inflation.

headline: Intel delays flagship chip and cuts guidance
body: Intel delayed its next flagship processor to next year and cut revenue guidance, citing manufacturing yield problems. Shares slumped 9% in pre-market trading.

headline: Sovereign downgraded as fiscal deficit widens
body: A rating agency downgraded an emerging-market sovereign by two notches, warning of a widening fiscal deficit and rising default risk. The currency weakened sharply.

headline: Coca-Cola launches zero-sugar line in 40 new markets
body: Coca-Cola announced the launch of its new zero-sugar product line across 40 markets, supported by strong early demand in pilot regions.

headline: Treasury yields spike as bond auction sees weak demand
body: A weak 10-year Treasury auction sent yields sharply higher. Strategists warned the sell-off could tighten financial conditions further.

headline: Bank of America beats estimates on strong wealth management
body: Bank of America reported earnings above estimates, driven by record wealth management fees and stable credit quality.
